Unit 6 is located in a meticulously restored 6 unit Victorian building on Broderick between Turk and Golden Gate. The entire building has been completely rebuilt from the studs up with new high end kitchens and bathrooms alongside modern appliances, fixtures and finishes.
Unit 6 is a new ground floor unit with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, large gourmet kitchen, spacious living room and dining room, separate entrance and new oak flooring throughout. The master bedroom has large east facing windows, full bathroom and a large walk in closet . The second bedroom also has has large east facing windows and ample closet space. Bedroom 3 sits quietly in the back of the unit with ample closet space. This space would be perfect for a home office, work out room or play room.
This unit has a brand new gourmet kitchen with new stainless steel, energy efficient, appliances (refridgerator/freezer, stove, dishwasher), Caeserstone countertops, ample cabinets, large pantry and new oak flooring. The modern bathrooms are brand new with Haisa stone flooring, bathtub, sleek Grohe fixtures and modern cabinets.
Located on a quiet street but only one block away from the Divisadero Corridor featuring Nopa/Nopalito restaurants, Bi-Rite Market, Falletti Foods, Pete's Coffee, Bar Crudo, The Independent,  Little Star Pizza and much more. Close to the Muni lines: 5 Fulton, 24 Divisadero and 38 Geary. Get to CalTrain in under 15 minutes.
Walking distance to Kaiser and Mount Zion,  and a short distance from UCSF. Walk the kids to school: several options are close including San Francisco Day School and Creative Arts Charter School.
1 compact car parking available.

•	Forced air heating gas

•	New Oak Hardwood floors throughout, Haisa stone flooring in bathroom
•	Laundry on premises
•	Intercom
Conditions:

•	 No pets and no canines due to highly allergic tenant and shared laundry.
•	Owner pays for hot and cold water and garbage
•	One Year Lease - Rent: $8000 month

First showing: Friday, September 24 at 5:00-6:00 PM — reply to confirm.
This full-floor Victorian flat offers more than 1,500 square feet near Divisadero and Alamo Square, with high ceilings, bay windows, wood floors and original period details.
The layout includes three bedrooms and two adjoining front parlors. Pocket doors separate the parlors, each opens onto the hallway, and one has a closet. The flexible layout offers space for living and dining, or a home office while retaining a separate living room.
The eat-in kitchen has a dishwasher, plenty of cabinet space and room for a dining table. There is one full bathroom, a separate second toilet room and a large hallway storage closet. Windows along multiple sides of the flat bring in natural light.
Divisadero's cafes, restaurants and shops are around the corner, with The Mill, Nopa and Bi-Rite nearby. Alamo Square Park is a few blocks away. Nearby Muni service includes the 5/5R Fulton and 24 Divisadero.

Description:
Remodeled Two-Level 3-Bedroom Mission Cottage with Garage, Storage & Laundry
Located at 19th Street and Capp Street in the heart of the Mission, this beautifully remodeled two-level cottage offers three bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and the privacy and separation of space that is hard to find in a typical San Francisco rental.
Just one block from the Valencia Street corridor, the home is surrounded by some of San Francisco’s most popular restaurants, cafés, bars, shops, and neighborhood amenities, with Dolores Park just a short walk away.
The location is exceptionally convenient, with a Walk Score of 99 and Bike Score of 94. Both the 16th Street and 24th Street Mission BART stations are easily accessible, along with multiple nearby Muni lines.

Bright, top-floor 3BR/1BA Victorian flat in one of San Francisco’s sunniest and most convenient neighborhoods. Freshly painted with beautiful wood floors, double-pane windows, great natural light and original period details throughout. The home features a renovated kitchen and bathroom, dishwasher, in-unit washer/dryer, instant hot water, and a shared backyard. An oversized private garage is included, with room for one car plus ample bike, outdoor gear and storage space — or potentially two very compact cars. The building also has a larger shared washer/dryer, perfect for bedding and oversized loads.
Fantastic location just around the corner from the restaurants, cafés and shops along 24th Street, with an easy walk to 24th St BART, Valencia Street and Precita Park. Quick freeway access makes getting south down the Peninsula or east across the Bay Bridge easy. Tenant pays PG&E and internet; owner pays water and garbage. Deposit 1x monthly rent. This unit is subject to San Francisco rent control.

Convenient access to Muni and Highways 101 and 280 makes commuting easy.
